text: Day one. You line up seven packets on your hostel shelf like trophies. Your roommate films it for the group chat. You're not alone, by the way. India ate over six hundred crore servings of Maggi in just fifteen months. Your whole day costs around a hundred rupees. Cheaper than one pizza. Two minutes a packet. Breakfast, Maggi. Lunch, Maggi. Dinner, Maggi. {deadpan} Easiest five thousand rupees of your life.
